description: Points www at the website Off the Clock Software built for the business, through the site's own name under otcsites.com, and forwards the bare domain to www with a permanent (301) redirect. Email records (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC and every other TXT record) are never changed.
variableDescription: %slug%: one DNS label that names the client's site under otcsites.com, for example joes-pizza.
